$comment: Golf variants reuse a parent challenge's test cases and assertions verbatim. They are configuration, not authoring — the build script expands each entry by cloning the parent's `tests` and `defaultAssert`, swapping mode to 'golf', and attaching the efficiency bonus. Nothing here needs its own promptfoo YAML.

public.goal: Same task as 'Strict JSON address extractor' — but now the prompt has to be short. Pass every test case first; only then does brevity earn points. Par is 84 tokens.
constraintsShown: Correctness is scored exactly as in the original challenge
The efficiency bonus applies only once you pass

public.goal: Same task as 'One label, nothing else' — now in as few tokens as possible. Pass every test case first; only then does brevity earn points. Par is 40 tokens.
constraintsShown: Correctness is scored exactly as in the original challenge
The efficiency bonus applies only once you pass

bonusFormula: efficiencyBonus = round(20 * max(0, 1 - promptTokens / parTokens)), applied only when meanCaseScore >= passThreshold, and capped so total <= 100
$note: Par values are the token counts of the reference prompts in the parent YAML files. Re-measure them with the same tokeniser the Worker uses before shipping — a par that is wrong by 20% makes the bonus either trivial or unreachable.
